purpose: Teach: 操る/根元/下回る/追いかける/雇わ/不変/定住/外れる

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが船を上手に操る方だった
lines.en: You know, Gran — when he was young, my father really knew how to handle a boat.
lines.style: Soft, gazing inward. Slow opening. The voice of someone remembering something he wishes he'd told his father he noticed. Gentle landing on each image.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、お庭の木の根元に水をやってらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He did, didn't he? And I remember you watering the roots of that tree in the garden, so careful about it.
lines.style: Warm, slightly teasing redirect. She's gently steering him back to something he did, not just his father. Affectionate correction. Gentle rise at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは目標を下回る事を恥とされた
lines.en: When he was young, my father — he saw falling short of a goal as a real shame. He couldn't let it go.
lines.style: Quieter now. The weight of old standards settling in his voice. Respectful of the man his father was, but not quite free from it. Measured, searching for the right word.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様を追いかけるのが楽しみだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He was like that, yes — but do you remember how much he loved chasing the grandchildren? He'd light right up.
lines.style: Tender insistence. She's not arguing with him, she's reminding him. A little twinkle underneath. She knows what he needs to hear.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが信頼できる人を雇われた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, he was particular about who he trusted. But once he did — he was loyal to them.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost careful. He's sorting through what mattered. Slight pause before 'loyal,' like he's settling on the exact word. Respect in the pacing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ご家族への愛情が不変だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: That's true — and his love for the family never wavered, not once in all those years.
lines.style: Firm and sure. She's not adding to what he said; she's confirming it. A small, solid certainty. She's been there to witness it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは故郷に定住する事を選ばれた
lines.en: When he was young, he chose to settle here, in his hometown. That meant something to him.
lines.style: Voice opening slightly, like a door to a quiet decision. Not nostalgia — clarity. He's understood something more now. Respectful pace. Lands gently on 'hometown.'

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、入れ歯が外れる時のお話、可笑しかったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh, and do you remember when his false teeth came out at dinner that time? We laughed so hard — even he did.
lines.style: Bright, small laugh underneath the words. She's dissolving the solemnity with a real memory of joy. Conspiratorial warmth. Trailing off with affection and mischief.
